rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ADAsilthe
Exhibition name: Isabelle Autissier ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, 1999).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 1998 as 'Belle Epoque'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, pink shading. Peach pink. Mild to strong, fruity fragrance. 30 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Large, long buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, upright. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 47" (90 to 120cm). Width: 2' to 28" (60 to 70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Parentage:
Decor Arlequin ×
Silver Jubilee ® (hybrid tea, Cocker before 1974)
rows.Notes: 'Isabelle Autissier' was chosen by the members of l'Association des Journalistes de l'Horticulture as its Rose 2000.
